text:
erin: FYI noticed CI SAST/DAST spike after last-night key rotation. Nightly gate failed.

mike: Saw that. Many findings point at endpoints that hit the auth refresh path. Responses include 'token refresh failed' HTML.

scanner-bot: alert: +73 findings (reflected-xss / open-redirect). Samples: /oauth/refresh, /files/preview returning HTML with user params.

infra-bot: keystore:rotate initiated 01:14 UTC; ephemeral_grant calls from svc-refresh show 403 at 01:15, success at 01:16.

mike: Likely an RBAC timing window during rotation causing refresh flow to return error pages; scanner flags those as vulns.

erin: I don't want long-lived ignores. Can we do a short-lived, targeted suppression in CI that matches the token-refresh error body and only on staging? Add an expiry.

remy: Agree. I'll open INFRA ticket to include grant context (requestor, grant_id) in keystore audit logs so we can correlate. Owner: remy.

mike: I'll repro locally and capture raw HTTP bodies, attach to PR. Plan: temp suppression patch + evidence + follow-up to pin proto generator (for other noise we saw).

erin: Add note to postmortem template: when infra key ops occur, include scanner diffs and raw audit lines.

oncall: Acknowledged. Monitoring overnight. If suppression extends >7 days, security-oncall will escalate.

scanner-bot: update: CI run with targeted suppression passed. Reminder: suppression must be reverted after mitigations.

erin: Thanks. Keeping thread open until audit logs include grant metadata and repro is fixed.
